entity.title: Merge decisions
entity.description: When the action may merge a pull request it approved, and how.

rules.body: The action MUST NOT merge a pull request unless the matching policy enables merging, which is off by default.
The action MUST NOT merge with the workflow GITHUB_TOKEN, only with the configured merge token, because a merge by that token starts no workflow.
The action MUST merge only the head commit it evaluated, and only when GitHub reports the pull request as cleanly mergeable.
The action MUST merge only with the method the policy names, or else the single method the base branch rules allow, refusing to merge when the two disagree or no single method is allowed.
The action MUST NOT merge a release pull request while the source branch holds a commit the changelog would show.
